worst_flaw: A group-level paid half-day for hitting 80% on time is a high-stakes cliff reward for an audience already sceptical of gamification. It is tested only through a short, admittedly contaminated staggered comparison, with no plain-feedback-only arm to isolate what the reward adds. That leaves rushed rubber-stamp reviews as the main risk, and a 5-review weekly sample may be too small to catch them.
